digest: RNA-targeting CRISPR systems are commonly evaluated by RT-qPCR, but guide RNA binding can confound these measurements.
We show that crRNA alone produces apparent knockdown without reducing target RNA abundance, whereas RNA sequencing remains unbiased and reveals guide-associated transcriptomic perturbations.
A simple RNA denaturation step before reverse transcription restores accurate RT-qPCR quantification, providing practical guidance for RNA-targeting CRISPR analysis and guide design.

digest: Open tuberculosis (TB) chest X-ray benchmarks can reward acquisition-source recognition instead of disease recognition: the same model can look excellent or weak depending only on the evaluation split.
Models routinely report AUROC above 0.95 on these benchmarks yet degrade at deployment sites.
Where the two classes never share an acquisition source, disease and source are confounded by construction: no image-only analysis can separate them without additional assumptions.

digest: Cross-sectional analyses of more than 150,000 participants show an association between higher physical activity levels and delayed menopause.

These findings establish physical activity as a behavioral intervention and adiponectin as a molecular target for delaying ovarian aging.

9832a0e926f6b766.title: Physical activity delays ovarian aging in part through adiponectin-related signaling pathways
digest: Physical activity has geroprotective properties, yet its role in ovarian aging is incompletely understood.

Here, a cross-sectional analysis of human cohorts links lower physical activity with menopause, while in mice, exercise delays ovarian aging at least in part by boosting adiponectin levels; an adiponectin receptor agonist reproduces these protective effects.

digest: Lead sponsor: Merck Sharp & Dohme LLC. Conditions: Non-small Cell Lung Cancer.

The goal of this study is to evaluate intismeran autogene plus pembrolizumab versus placebo plus pembrolizumab for the adjuvant treatment of margin negative, completely resected Stage II, IIIA, IIIB (with nodal involvement \[N2\]) non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC).
The primary hypothesis is that intismeran autogene plus pembrolizumab is superior to placebo plus pembrolizumab with respect to disease-free survival (DFS) as assessed by the investigator.

9ceccac3135c465f.title: Review of Obesity and Cancer
digest: To the Editor Dr Shen and colleagues provided a timely and useful Review of the biological links between obesity and cancer.
They appropriately identified hepatobiliary cancer as one of the malignancies most strongly associated with excess adiposity and include liver cancer among obesity-related cancers.

evidence.quote: Review of Obesity and Cancer.
In the liver, excess adiposity commonly converges with steatosis, inflammatory activity, fibrogenesis, and progressive architectural distortion before hepatocellular carcinoma develops.

Thus, the liver is not simply another organ exposed to systemic inflammation, altered hormone signaling, oxidative stress, immune dysregulation, and microbiome changes; it is an organ in which metabolic injury becomes the local carcinogenic

f25f13fbaa04f226.title: Capricor soars on plan to amend DMD filing after adcomm setback
digest: Capricor Therapeutics has bounced back from a bruising FDA advisory committee meeting by securing a green light to file an amendment to its approval application, raising hopes that the biotech can rescue its Duchenne muscular dystrophy cell therapy. The biotech’s stock soared following the news.

ac07b56fd9c0ba83.title: Long term use and replacement of near vision glasses for presbyopia, in Punjab, Pakistan: a cross-sectional survey
digest: Methods: In this cross-sectional survey, 276 individuals who received near vision glasses through eye health screening programs in Punjab province, Pakistan from 2020 to 2022, were surveyed between February and July 2025, i.e. 3-5 years later.
Results: 92.0% (n=254) of respondents were still using near vision glasses: a purchased replacement (41.3%, n=114), a free replacement (30.8%, n=85), or the original pair (19.9%, n=55).

5f958fe3628135a2.title: Plasticity of human microglia and brain perivascular macrophages in aging and Alzheimer’s disease
digest: Molecular profiling of myeloid cells from the prefrontal cortex of 1,607 donors with varying degrees of Alzheimer’s disease neuropathology delineates distinct myeloid subtypes and identifies changes associated with aging and disease progression.
